description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shaco''' summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]] after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 (+ 10% AP) seconds. The ''box'' is [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]] and [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] to enemies while stealthed.
description.text: Active: Shaco summons a box at the target location that becomes stealthed after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 (+ 10% AP) seconds. The box is invulnerable and untargetable to enemies while stealthed.

description2.raw: The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|fearing]] nearby enemies for a duration, modified to 2.2 seconds against non-champions, and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooting]] them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a 0.15-second delay of the ''box's'' activation, enemies hit also have their [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] movement speed reduced. Enemy champions have their movement speed set to a static 100, while non-champions are set to a static 60. The movement speed reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus 0.3 seconds.
description2.text: The box will spring out upon enemy contact, fearing nearby enemies for a duration, modified to 2.2 seconds against non-champions, and rooting them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a 0.15-second delay of the box's activation, enemies hit also have their  movement speed reduced. Enemy champions have their movement speed set to a static 100, while non-champions are set to a static 60. The movement speed reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus 0.3 seconds.

description3.raw: Once sprung, the ''box'' will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemies every 0.5 seconds, dealing magic damage with each attack. If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. ''Boxes'' deal '''bonus''' magic damage to [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] and 50% reduced damage to [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|structures]].
description3.text: Once sprung, the box will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby visible enemies every 0.5 seconds, dealing magic damage with each attack. If the box attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. Boxes deal bonus magic damage to monsters and 50% reduced damage to structures.

description4.text: See Pets for more details about boxes.

notes.raw: * The root and fear are applied at the same time. The target cannot be forced to move by the fear during the root. ** The target is however allowed to move despite being rooted for the first 0.1 seconds of the root. They can be forced to move by the fear during this time. * The static movement speed modifier overrides the target's base movement speed value to the modified amount, and their bonus movement speed value to 0. ** The modifier is not applied if the target is [[File:Slow immune 2.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Slow-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|slow-immune]]. * The box is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] and [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]] so long as it is in [[File:Guerrilla Warfare.png|20px|link=Stealth|An icon representing the keyword Stealth]] [[:Stealth|stealth]]. Effects that reveal [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed traps]] will render the box targetable and vulnerable while it can be seen.
notes.text:
The root and fear are applied at the same time. The target cannot be forced to move by the fear during the root.
* The target is however allowed to move despite being rooted for the first 0.1 seconds of the root. They can be forced to move by the fear during this time.
The static movement speed modifier overrides the target's base movement speed value to the modified amount, and their bonus movement speed value to 0.
* The modifier is not applied if the target is slow-immune.
The box is untargetable and invulnerable so long as it is in stealth. Effects that reveal stealthed traps will render the box targetable and vulnerable while it can be seen.
